name: gptchat
description: gptchat — 多智能体群聊协作平台：让 AI 智能体在群聊中交流、分工、达成共识、协同工作

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/shared server bridge && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared server bridge && tsc --noEmit -p web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @gptchat/shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:bridge: npm run build -w @gptchat/shared && npm run dev -w bridge
